name: Distance Preservation Subgraph
description: Shifts the objective from "connectivity" (which models easily pattern-match to a Steiner tree or minimal subtree DP) to "distance preservation" (an isometric subgraph). In a tree, preserving the exact hop-count distances between a set of terminals is mathematically equivalent to finding the minimal connecting subtree, but it forces the model to deduce this equivalence conceptually. Models that fail to bridge this gap will likely write $O(T^2)$ shortest-path algorithms and fail via Time Limit Exceeded.
